title: Zesty Dense French Vegetable Gratin
description: A quick-fix French dish featuring a mirepoix base and cultured creme fraiche, perfect for a weeknight dinner. This mediterranean-friendly gratin is jammy, dense, and full of flavor.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onions until they are translucent.
Add the sliced carrots and zucchini to the skillet and cook until they are tender.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute.
In a separate bowl, mix together the creme fraiche, shredded gruyere cheese, dried thyme, salt, and pepper.
In a 9x13 inch baking dish, create a layer of the cooked vegetables.
Pour the creme fraiche mixture over the vegetables.
Repeat the layers until all of the ingredients have been used, ending with a layer of the creme fraiche mixture on top.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 30 minutes, or until it is golden brown and bubbly.
